meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 安装后,每当你成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类调用,插件会自动做一次注释检查;若报出警告,Claude 会收到阻塞式反馈,必须先修复或解释被标记的注释,再继续下一步。
howto.when: 在一次编辑类调用(如 apply_patch、write、edit 等)成功执行之后,comment-checker 报出警告时接管。

say.text: comment-checker 报了警告,帮我处理那条注释
say.note: Claude 读取反馈后修复或解释被标记的注释

say.text: 把被标记的那条注释直接删掉
这条注释是必要的,帮我写清楚保留它的理由
say.note: Claude 给出保留该注释的说明

howto.what_en: After a successful apply_patch, write, or edit call, the plugin runs a comment check; if it warns, Claude receives blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: When a comment-checker warning is emitted after a successful edit-like call such as apply_patch, write, or edit.

say_en.text: comment-checker flagged a comment—help me deal with it
say_en.note: Claude reads the warning, then fixes or explains the comment

say_en.text: That comment is needed—help me justify keeping it
say_en.note: Claude explains why the comment stays
